episodes.title: En carne y hueso
episodes.summary: Camila is swept off her feet by handsome Fernando. After a dreamy night out, they end up at his hotel suite… unaware they're being watched.

episodes.title: Pánico en el paraíso
episodes.summary: A misunderstanding allows for Camila and David to move into Riviera Esmeralda. Pedro tests Miguel. Camila is hell-bent on uncovering the truth.

episodes.title: Aunque duela
episodes.summary: Camila is furious after finding out what's making the rounds online. David questions her desire to stay. A question from Lucas catches her off guard.

episodes.title: Sin aliento
episodes.summary: Ángela extracts a promise from Lucas, but what he asks in return startles her. Pedro tells Tina that Miguel has taken the bait. Camila acts dismissively.

episodes.title: Imágenes peligrosas
episodes.summary: The incident at Camila's home triggers vivid flashbacks for her. Lucas warns Ángela about what the police might find. Pedro calls a meeting.

episodes.title: El secreto de Red Velvet
episodes.summary: Ángela makes a decision about her marriage. Visions of Inti haunt Adrián. One of Miguel's past lovers shares intimate details of their relationship.

episodes.title: La boca del lobo
episodes.summary: Someone surprising comes to Camila's defense. Inti's seduction attempts persist. Camila leaves a party alone — and puts herself in imminent danger.

episodes.title: Tentación en la oscuridad
episodes.summary: Ángela becomes increasingly cynical. Camila receives a word of caution from an unlikely character. Cris spices things up with Adrián.

episodes.title: La noche de los ejecutores
episodes.summary: Camila refuses to assist with an event, and is promptly reminded of what's at stake if she doesn't. What Pedro discovers provokes a hellish response.

episodes.title: No digas nada
episodes.summary: An accident leaves the community mourning. Something unthinkable comes to light as a visit to Ángela culminates in a calamitous scene.

episodes.title: El sueño prohibido
episodes.summary: Ahead of her wedding to David, Camila finds herself haunted by memories of Miguel. Ángela's celebration of her newfound freedom is short-lived.

episodes.title: Perder el control
episodes.summary: Camila reminisces about the past and resists temptation as Miguel preys on her emotions. Sparks fly during Laura's first date. Ángela points fingers.

episodes.title: Anatomía de una obsesión
episodes.summary: As the killings rattle Riviera Esmerelda, Miguel tries to make amends with his kids. David proposes a chilling theory. Detective Indira questions Inti.

episodes.title: El hombre que nunca existió
episodes.summary: With her marriage to David on the rocks, Camila takes out a restraining order against Miguel. Indira uncovers a common thread between the murders.

episodes.title: Al filo del placer
episodes.summary: In Mexico, Camila mixes business with pleasure. Miguel takes his meddling to the next level. Laura and Matteo grow closer despite her son's disapproval.

episodes.title: La chica que sabía demasiado
episodes.summary: Passion and betrayal collide when Camila gets a deceiving invitation. Ángela reasserts her control of the company. For Inti, freedom comes at a cost.

episodes.title: Ella/Él sabe que estás sola
episodes.summary: Fueled by her desire for vengeance and reeling from the events of Mexico, Camila returns to Riviera Esmerelda to find Red Velvet — and goes rogue.

episodes.title: Ojos que no ven
episodes.summary: Jealousies flare as Camila recovers and new evidence puts Miguel under police scrutiny once more. Inti comes forward with a damning discovery.

episodes.title: La muerte juega al golf
episodes.summary: The hunt for the killer narrows, testing relationships and triggering old wounds. Ángela lashes out. Camila's therapy session takes a harrowing turn.

episodes.title: La sangre y la esperanza
episodes.summary: True colors come to light as Indira makes a break in the case, Ángela does damage control and Camila learns just how far a master manipulator can go.

episodes.title: El límite del deseo
episodes.summary: Camila and Miguel befriend a young couple on their honeymoon, to Miguel's alarm. Indira receives shocking news that'll change everything.

episodes.title: La sobreviviente
episodes.summary: Camila and Miguel attend a different kind of therapy as the Riviera Esmeralda gets a new resident. A new killer targets one of Camila's own.

episodes.title: La tentación llama a la puerta
episodes.summary: Unexpected guests drive a deeper wedge between Miguel and Camila. Eva overhears a private conversation that threatens to disrupt it all.

episodes.title: Sólo para fans
episodes.summary: As temptation sets in, Camila's urges threaten to consume her. Police close in on a murder suspect, as Ángela gets a taste of freedom through pain.

episodes.title: Gente súper decente
episodes.summary: Rodrigo and Juanita receive a nasty surprise as Camila and Miguel try to repair their marriage. Laura discovers betrayal is closer than she thought.

episodes.title: El hombre de los mil rostros
episodes.summary: Miguel unleashes his past – and secrets — to Camila. As another death rocks Riviera Esmeralda, Ángela's trial changes everything. A copycat runs free.

episodes.title: Esto nunca fue amor
episodes.summary: Doubts cloud Camila's mind as an attack causes a rift at Golden Lips. Inti crashes an intimate gathering, and Vannessa's jealousy becomes a threat.

episodes.title: Inclinaciones ocultas
episodes.summary: Indira makes an arrest in Alberto's death. When a trap goes awry, Camila smells a rat. Miguel's debts and lies catch up to him. Alonso is attacked.

episodes.title: Remordimiento
episodes.summary: Inti's obsession resurfaces as Noa meets Ángela. Vannessa bows to pressure, and an innocent party becomes the scene of a devastating disappearance.

episodes.title: Todo es fake
episodes.summary: The search for Eva continues, and so do Ángela's schemes. An arrest gives Indira a wealth of information, and a special show has a terrible fallout.
